name: wealthcore
description: WealthCore - Your Entire Financial Life. One Intelligent Core. A private, personal financial operating system.

scripts.lint: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/routes/api.js && node --check server/lib/*.js && node --check server/db/*.js && node --check server/config.js
scripts.audit:secrets: grep -rInE 'API_KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD|PRIVATE_KEY|BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE' server public --include='*.js' | grep -vE 'WEALTHCORE_|SETU_CLIENT_ID|SETU_CLIENT_SECRET|SETU_PRODUCT_INSTANCE_ID|_CLIENT_SECRET|_PRODUCT_INSTANCE_ID|_CLIENT_ID|clientSecret|client_secret|productInstanceId|product_instance_id|clientId|client_id|process\\.env|password_hash|password_salt|session|Bearer|token,|req\\.body|headers\\.authorization|NO_SECRET_CONFIGURED|credentials required|READY_FOR_CONFIGURATION' || echo 'No hard-coded secrets found.'
scripts.config:setu: node --input-type=module -e "import {config,validateSetuConfig} from './server/config.js';const r=validateSetuConfig(config());console.log('SETU_ENVIRONMENT: '+r.environment.toLowerCase());for(const f of r.configuredFields)console.log(f.key+': '+((f.present)?'configured':'NOT SET'));console.log(r.missing.length?('MISSING: '+r.missing.join(', ')):'All required Setu credentials present.');console.log('configured: '+r.configured);process.exit(r.missing.length?1:0)"
